name: Unidentified OOM command battle droid 1 (Ryloth)
description: An OOM command battle droid served as a commander during the Battle of Ryloth. They were responsible for leading the Armored Assault Tank Mk Is on Ryloth against attacking AT-TEs that were commanded by Jedi General Mace Windu. During the skirmish, the droid commander was destroyed along with the AATs by Windu and Lightning Squadron.
